available.quote: the Board may grant a temporary license to engage in the practice of dietetics in this State to a person who holds a corresponding license in another jurisdiction if: (a) The corresponding license is in good standing; and (b) The requirements for licensure in the other jurisdiction are substantially equal to the requirements for licensure in this State.

requirements.value: Corresponding license in another jurisdiction must be in good standing and requirements substantially equal to Nevada's. Temporary license valid for 10-day period.
requirements.quote: A temporary license is valid for the 10-day period designated on the license.

authority.quote: If any member of the Board or a Dietitian Advisory Group established pursuant to NRS 640E.130 becomes aware of any ground for initiating disciplinary action against a licensee, the member shall file an administrative complaint with the Board.

national_certification.quote: The application must include evidence that the applicant is a registered dietitian in good standing.

scope_protection.quote: If a person is not licensed to engage in the practice of dietetics pursuant to this chapter... the person shall not: 1. Engage in the practice of dietetics

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraud or deceit in procuring or attempting to procure a license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is guilty of fraud or deceit in procuring or attempting to procure a license pursuant to this chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of an offense involving moral turpitude or relating to the qualifications or duties of a licensee
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is guilty of any offense: (1) Involving moral turpitude; or (2) Relating to the qualifications, functions or duties of a licensee.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Use of controlled substances, dangerous drugs, or intoxicating liquor in a dangerous manner or impairing ability to practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Uses any controlled substance, dangerous drug as defined in chapter 454 of NRS, or intoxicating liquor to an extent or in a manner which is dangerous or injurious to any other person or which impairs his or her ability to conduct the practice authorized by the license.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Permitting another person to use the licensee's license to engage in the practice of dietetics
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Permitting or allowing another person to use his or her license to engage in the practice of dietetics.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Repeated malpractice, which may be evidenced by settled malpractice claims
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Repeated malpractice, which may be evidenced by claims of malpractice settled against the licensee.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Physical, verbal or psychological abuse of a patient
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Physical, verbal or psychological abuse of a patient.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction for use or unlawful possession of a controlled substance or dangerous drug
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conviction for the use or unlawful possession of a controlled substance or dangerous drug as defined in chapter 454 of NRS.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willfully or repeatedly violated any provision of the chapter
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has willfully or repeatedly violated any provision of this chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Aiding or abetting any person in violating any provision of the chapter
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is guilty of aiding or abetting any person in violating any provision of this chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Disciplined in another state in connection with dietetics practice or committed an act in another state that would violate this chapter
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has been disciplined in another state in connection with the practice of dietetics or has committed an act in another state which would constitute a violation of this chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaged in conduct likely to deceive, defraud or endanger a patient or the general public
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has engaged in conduct likely to deceive, defraud or endanger a patient or the general public.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willfully failed to comply with a regulation, subpoena or order of the Board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has willfully failed to comply with a regulation, subpoena or order of the Board.

definition_quote.value: "Practice of dietetics" means the performance of any act in the nutrition care process, including, without limitation, assessment, evaluation, diagnosis, counseling, intervention, monitoring and treatment, of a person which requires substantial specialized judgment and skill based on the knowledge, application and integration of the principles derived from the sciences of food, nutrition, management, communication, biology, behavior, physiology and social science to achieve and maintain proper nourishment and care of the health of the person.
definition_quote.quote: "Practice of dietetics" means the performance of any act in the nutrition care process, including, without limitation, assessment, evaluation, diagnosis, counseling, intervention, monitoring and treatment, of a person which requires substantial specialized judgment and skill based on the knowledge, application and integration of the principles derived from the sciences of food, nutrition, management, communication, biology, behavior, physiology and social science to achieve and maintain proper nourishment and care of the health of the person.

value: recommending method of obtaining nourishment (oral, intravenous, feeding tube)
counseling and advice on health and disease regarding nutrition
treating nutritional problems and identifying patient outcomes
planning activities to change behavior, risk factors, environmental conditions
developing, implementing and managing nutrition care systems
accepting and transmitting verbal and electronic orders from a physician
ordering special diet or nutritional supplement including medical nutrition therapy
ordering medical laboratory tests when authorized by physician written protocol
medical nutrition therapy to manage, treat or rehabilitate disease/illness/injury
methods_authorized.quote: A licensed dietitian shall provide nutrition services to assist a person in achieving and maintaining proper nourishment and care of his or her body, including, without limitation

license_type_structure.quote: "Licensed dietitian" means a person licensed pursuant to this chapter to engage in the practice of dietetics or to provide nutrition services

provisional_license_available.quote: the Board may grant a provisional license to engage in the practice of dietetics in this State to an applicant who provides evidence to the Board that the applicant is eligible to take, but has not successfully completed, the Registration Examination for Dietitians

provisional_license_duration_months.quote: A provisional license is valid for 1 year after the date of issuance.

provisional_license_requires_supervision.quote: A person who holds a provisional license may engage in the practice of dietetics only under the supervision of a licensed dietitian.

dietetic_technician_recognized.quote: "Licensed dietitian" means a person licensed pursuant to this chapter to engage in the practice of dietetics or to provide nutrition services

rd_credential_accepted_in_lieu_of_state_.quote: The application must include evidence that the applicant is a registered dietitian in good standing.

medical_nutrition_therapy_authorized.quote: "Licensed dietitian" means a person licensed pursuant to this chapter to engage in the practice of dietetics or to provide nutrition services, including, without limitation, medical nutrition therapy.

enteral_parenteral_nutrition_authorized.quote: Recommending the appropriate method of obtaining proper nourishment, including, without limitation, orally, intravenously or through a feeding tube

diet_order_writing_authority.quote: Ordering a special diet or nutritional supplement, including, without limitation, medical nutrition therapy, to address the nutritional needs of a patient

lab_test_ordering_authority.quote: Ordering medical laboratory tests relating to the therapeutic treatment concerning the nutritional needs of a patient when authorized to do so by a written protocol prepared or approved by a physician.

physician_referral_required.quote: Ordering medical laboratory tests relating to the therapeutic treatment concerning the nutritional needs of a patient when authorized to do so by a written protocol prepared or approved by a physician.

diagnosis_treatment_prohibition.quote: A licensed dietitian shall not provide medical diagnosis of the health of a person.

value: doctor of Oriental medicine in any form
exempt_professions_list.quote: Any person who is licensed or registered in this State as a physician pursuant to chapter 630, 630A or 633 of NRS, dentist, nurse, dispensing optician, optometrist, occupational therapist, practitioner of respiratory care, physical therapist, podiatric physician, psychologist, marriage and family therapist, chiropractic physician, naprapath, athletic trainer, massage therapist, reflexologist, structural integration practitioner, perfusionist, doctor of Oriental medicine in any form, medical laboratory director or technician or pharmacist who: (1) Practices within the scope of that license or registration; (2) Does not represent that he or she is a licensed dietitian or registered dietitian; and (3) Provides nutrition information incidental to the practice for which he or she is licensed or registered.

federal_employee_exemption.quote: A registered dietitian employed by the Armed Forces of the United States, the United States Department of Veterans Affairs or any division or department of the Federal Government in the discharge of his or her official duties, including, without limitation, the practice of dietetics or providing nutrition services.

weight_control_program_exemption.quote: A person who provides services relating to weight loss or weight control through a program reviewed by and in consultation with a licensed dietitian or physician or a dietitian licensed or registered in another state which has equivalent licensure requirements as this State, as long as the person does not change the services or program without the approval of the person with whom he or she is consulting.

food_supplement_sales_exemption.quote: A person who furnishes nutrition information, provides recommendations or advice concerning nutrition, or markets food, food materials or dietary supplements and provides nutrition information, recommendations or advice related to that marketing, if the person does not represent that he or she is a licensed dietitian or registered dietitian.

nonresident_temporary_practice_allowed.quote: the Board may grant a temporary license to engage in the practice of dietetics in this State to a person who holds a corresponding license in another jurisdiction

nonresident_temporary_practice_max_days.quote: A temporary license is valid for the 10-day period designated on the license.

protected_titles.quote: Use in connection with his or her name the words or letters "L.D.," "licensed dietitian" or any other letters, words or insignia indicating or implying that he or she is licensed to engage in the practice of dietetics, or in any other way, orally, or in writing or print, or by sign, directly or by implication, use the word "dietetics" or represent himself or herself as licensed or qualified to engage in the practice of dietetics in this State
